title: Voxi TTS Playback Tuning
description: Playback tuning for monitor-gated text to speech.

trailing_silence_trim_ms.description: Maximum trailing quiet audio to remove from each synthesized chunk, in milliseconds.

trailing_silence_threshold_db.description: PCM amplitude threshold in dBFS; samples below this level count as trailing silence.

url.description: Local tts-serve HTTP endpoint (issue 157 API); voxi does not install or launch the server.

timeout_ms.description: Request timeout; Chatterbox on CPU costs about 10s of compute per 1s of audio.

reference_wav.description: Reference WAV for voice cloning; empty until a voice profile is configured.

settings.description: Passed through verbatim as the request's settings object.

max_chunk_runes.description: tts-serve only: sentences longer than this are re-split at clause/word boundaries before being sent, so one request stays well under timeout_ms. Piper chunking is unaffected.
